title: PLAIN TEA CAKE
instructions: --Cream two level tablespoons of butter and one cup of sugar together, add one beaten egg, one cup of
milk and two cups of flour in which three level teaspoons of baking powder have been sifted. Bake in a sheet, and serve while fresh.
